title: 美联储主席沃什：加息是审慎决定，不预判未来，市场如何应对？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Thank you Colby Swift in the New York Times when the Fed starts raising rates it generally follows with a sequence of hikes Is there anything different in today's assessment of the economic conditions that would suggest that the typical
segments.zh: 谢谢Colby Swift在纽约时报的提问。当美联储开始加息时，通常会跟随一系列加息。今天的评估中是否有任何不同之处，表明典型模式不适用？

segments.en: Pattern does not apply and I guess second to that what impact you expect higher rates to have at this juncture if the bulk of What is keeping inflation elevated is stemming from supply shocks?
segments.zh: 其次，如果通胀高企主要源于供给冲击，您预计在当前节点加息会产生什么影响？

segments.en: So we're trying to get to more people so now I get to cherry pick my preferred question from you Colby This won't surprise you. I'm not the forward guidance business. The decision we made today was a sober decision
segments.zh: 我们正试图接触更多人，所以现在我可以挑选我偏好的问题。Colby，这不会让你意外。我不做前瞻指引。我们今天的决定是清醒的决定。

segments.en: Series decision responsible decision one that we have been preparing for and thinking about in my hundred and ten or twenty days here
segments.zh: 一系列决定，负责任的决定，一个我们在我在这里的110或120天里一直在准备和思考的决定。

segments.en: You heard from other people in the dots effectively what their forecasts are I'm not gonna pre-judge any future decisions we make
segments.zh: 你从其他人那里听到了点阵图，实际上是他们的预测。我不会预先判断我们未来做出的任何决定。

segments.en: You might have heard me saying Jackson Hole. I committed to a discipline set of principles I committed to look outside the window and see what I can observe
segments.zh: 你可能听我在杰克逊霍尔说过。我承诺了一套纪律性原则，我承诺看向窗外，看看我能观察到什么。

segments.en: That's what I did in Jackson. That's what we did today
segments.zh: 这就是我在杰克逊所做的。这就是我们今天所做的。
